name: Mahjong Arcade
author: PointNet Games
description: Mahjong Solitaire with dual Arcade and Classic modes: 330 progressive levels, 4-slot staging box in arcade, special 144-tile Classic Challenges with flower/season wildcards every 10 levels, combo scoring with x1.5 classic bonus, shuffle power-up, offline precompute solver. Mobile-first, no pan/zoom.
instructions: Tap a free tile to send it to the staging box. Two matching tiles in the box disappear. 4 tiles without a match = game over. Face-down tiles reveal their symbol on tap, then go to staging on second tap. Drag tiles to peek underneath.
